import { cwdSnapshot } from "./cwd.js";
import { Command, Environment, Input, Output, settings } from "./values.js";
import { environmentSnapshot } from "./environment.js";
import { OutputLimitError, ProcessAbortError, ProcessError, ProcessExitError, ProcessIOError, ProcessLaunchError, ProcessTeardownError, ProcessTimeoutError } from "./errors.js";
import childProcess from "node:child_process";
import { performance } from "node:perf_hooks";
import { addAbortListener } from "node:events";
//#region src/index.twill
var Capture = class {
	reader;
	policy;
	buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
	size = 0;
	constructor(reader, policy, channel, pid, fail, failed) {
		this.reader = reader;
		this.policy = policy;
		this.onData = (chunk) => {
			if (failed()) return;
			if (this.size + chunk.length > policy.limit) {
				fail(new OutputLimitError(channel, policy.limit, pid));
				return;
			}
			try {
				if (this.size === 0) this.buffer = chunk;
				else {
					const required = this.size + chunk.length;
					if (required > this.buffer.length) {
						const next = Buffer.allocUnsafe(Math.min(policy.limit, Math.max(required, this.buffer.length * 2)));
						this.buffer.copy(next, 0, 0, this.size);
						this.buffer = next;
					}
					chunk.copy(this.buffer, this.size);
				}
				this.size += chunk.length;
			} catch (cause) {
				fail(new ProcessIOError(channel, pid, cause));
			}
		};
		this.onError = (cause) => fail(pid === void 0 ? new ProcessLaunchError(cause) : new ProcessIOError(channel, pid, cause));
		reader.on("data", this.onData).on("error", this.onError);
	}
	onData;
	onError;
	value() {
		const bytes = this.buffer.subarray(0, this.size);
		return this.policy.kind === "text" ? bytes.toString("utf8") : bytes;
	}
	detach() {
		this.reader.off("data", this.onData).off("error", this.onError);
	}
};
var stdio = (policy) => policy.kind === "inherit" ? "inherit" : policy.kind === "discard" ? "ignore" : "pipe";
var emptyOptions = Object.freeze({});
function run(cmd, options = emptyOptions) {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		const config = settings(cmd, options);
		const { signal } = config;
		const submitted = config.timeoutMs === void 0 ? void 0 : performance.now();
		if (signal?.aborted) {
			reject(new ProcessAbortError(void 0, signal.reason));
			return;
		}
		let child;
		const input = typeof config.input === "string" ? config.input : config.input instanceof Uint8Array ? Buffer.from(Buffer.from(config.input.buffer, config.input.byteOffset, config.input.byteLength)) : void 0;
		try {
			child = childProcess.spawn(cmd.executable, cmd.arguments, {
				shell: false,
				cwd: config.cwd === void 0 ? void 0 : cwdSnapshot(config.cwd),
				env: config.environment === void 0 ? void 0 : environmentSnapshot(config.environment),
				stdio: [
					typeof config.input === "object" && !(config.input instanceof Uint8Array) ? config.input.kind === "inherit" ? "inherit" : "ignore" : "pipe",
					stdio(config.output),
					stdio(config.error)
				]
			});
		} catch (cause) {
			reject(new ProcessLaunchError(cause));
			return;
		}
		let primary;
		let closed = false, settled = false, inputClosed = child.stdin === null;
		let status;
		let timeout;
		let grace;
		let forced;
		let stdout, stderr;
		let abortListener;
		const failed = () => primary !== void 0;
		const clearTimers = () => {
			clearTimeout(timeout);
			clearTimeout(grace);
			clearTimeout(forced);
		};
		const destroyIO = () => {
			child.stdin?.destroy();
			child.stdout?.destroy();
			child.stderr?.destroy();
		};
		const cleanup = () => {
			clearTimers();
			abortListener?.[Symbol.dispose]();
			child.off("error", onError).off("exit", onExit).off("close", onClose);
			child.stdin?.off("error", onInputError).off("close", onInputClose);
			stdout?.detach();
			stderr?.detach();
		};
		const captured = (capture, stream) => {
			try {
				return capture?.value();
			} catch (cause) {
				const error = new ProcessIOError(stream, child.pid, cause);
				if (primary) primary.cleanupErrors.push(error);
				else primary = error;
				return;
			}
		};
		const finish = () => {
			if (settled || !closed || !inputClosed) return;
			settled = true;
			cleanup();
			const standardOutput = captured(stdout, "stdout"), standardError = captured(stderr, "stderr");
			if (primary) {
				Object.assign(primary, {
					terminationStatus: status,
					standardOutput,
					standardError
				});
				reject(primary);
			} else {
				const result = Object.freeze({
					processIdentifier: child.pid,
					terminationStatus: status,
					standardOutput,
					standardError
				});
				if (config.check && (status.kind !== "exited" || status.code !== 0)) reject(new ProcessExitError(result));
				else resolve(result);
			}
		};
		const secondary = (error) => primary.cleanupErrors.push(error);
		const kill = (signal) => {
			const errors = primary.cleanupErrors.length;
			try {
				if (!child.kill(signal) && child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null && child.pid !== void 0 && primary.cleanupErrors.length === errors) secondary(new ProcessError("Subprocess termination signal failed", child.pid));
			} catch (cause) {
				secondary(new ProcessError("Subprocess termination signal failed", child.pid, { cause }));
			}
		};
		const fail = (error) => {
			if (settled) return;
			if (primary) {
				secondary(error);
				return;
			}
			primary = error;
			clearTimeout(timeout);
			if (child.pid === void 0 || child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) {
				destroyIO();
				return;
			}
			kill("SIGTERM");
			grace = setTimeout(() => {
				if (closed) return;
				kill("SIGKILL");
				destroyIO();
				forced = setTimeout(() => {
					if (closed) return;
					const alive = child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null;
					secondary(alive ? new ProcessTeardownError(child.pid) : new ProcessError("Subprocess I/O did not close", child.pid));
					Object.assign(primary, {
						unresolvedProcessIdentifier: alive ? child.pid : void 0,
						standardOutput: captured(stdout, "stdout"),
						standardError: captured(stderr, "stderr")
					});
					settled = true;
					cleanup();
					child.unref();
					reject(primary);
				}, config.killTimeoutMs);
				forced.unref();
			}, config.gracePeriodMs);
			grace.unref();
		};
		const onAbort = () => {
			if (!closed) fail(new ProcessAbortError(child.pid, signal.reason));
		};
		const onError = (cause) => fail(child.pid === void 0 ? new ProcessLaunchError(cause) : new ProcessError("Subprocess process control failed", child.pid, { cause }));
		const onExit = () => {
			if (primary) destroyIO();
		};
		const onClose = (code, signal) => {
			closed = true;
			clearTimers();
			if (child.pid !== void 0) status = Object.freeze(signal !== null ? {
				kind: "signaled",
				signal
			} : {
				kind: "exited",
				code
			});
			finish();
		};
		const onInputError = (cause) => fail(child.pid === void 0 ? new ProcessLaunchError(cause) : new ProcessIOError("stdin", child.pid, cause));
		const onInputClose = () => {
			inputClosed = true;
			finish();
		};
		child.on("error", onError).once("exit", onExit).once("close", onClose);
		if (child.stdout) stdout = new Capture(child.stdout, config.output, "stdout", child.pid, fail, failed);
		if (child.stderr) stderr = new Capture(child.stderr, config.error, "stderr", child.pid, fail, failed);
		if (child.stdin) {
			child.stdin.on("error", onInputError).once("close", onInputClose);
			try {
				child.stdin.end(input);
			} catch (cause) {
				fail(new ProcessIOError("stdin", child.pid, cause));
			}
		}
		if (signal) {
			if (signal.aborted) onAbort();
			else try {
				abortListener = addAbortListener(signal, onAbort);
			} catch (cause) {
				fail(new ProcessError("Subprocess cancellation setup failed", child.pid, { cause }));
			}
		}
		if (config.timeoutMs !== void 0 && !primary) {
			timeout = setTimeout(() => fail(new ProcessTimeoutError(config.timeoutMs, child.pid)), Math.max(0, config.timeoutMs - (performance.now() - submitted)));
			timeout.unref();
		}
	});
}
var Subprocess = Object.freeze({ run });
//#endregion
export { Command, Environment, Input, Output, OutputLimitError, ProcessAbortError, ProcessError, ProcessExitError, ProcessIOError, ProcessLaunchError, ProcessTeardownError, ProcessTimeoutError, Subprocess };

//# sourceMappingURL=index.js.map
